background.description: White paper, signed in black ink

notes: SSC CHSL 2026 applications opened 7 September 2026 and use the same unified SSC application system as CGL: signature upload in JPEG/JPG, 10-20 KB (confirmed via SSC's official announcements for this cycle). Like CGL, SSC CHSL no longer requires a pre-made photo upload — the application captures a live photograph via webcam/mobile camera during form-filling, so there is no ssc-chsl-photo preset. Source link points to the SSC homepage rather than a specific notification PDF since this cycle's CHSL notification wasn't directly fetched for this verification; confirm signature specifics against the live CHSL notification on ssc.gov.in.
